allowed_before_registration: fixed-symbol fixed-date source probes after external timestamping
prohibited_before_registration: full-market or multi-year extraction from the bounded probe

semantic_requirements: close is an explicitly documented adjusted-close series
amount units and cutoff timing are documented
exact t, t+1, t+20, t+21 rows are available on the bound official calendar
current and delisted SH/SZ A-shares are retained
list and delist dates are security lifecycle facts, not current-only status
publishDate is the actual recorded disclosure date
no row has publishDate earlier than reportPeriodEnd
single-version rows are not called vintages or first-release values
each row is a common official SSE and SZSE open session
source provenance and disagreement resolution are retained
exact CSV bytes are hash-bound before registration

known_constraints: token, points, and endpoint entitlements must be verified
daily amount is reported in thousand CNY and volume in lots; conversion must be recorded
actual_date, not pre_date or ann_date, is the publication-date candidate
stock_basic alone does not prove historical point-in-time membership
the current service agreement describes a personal, non-transferable, non-commercial licence; written permission for local retention, aggregate publication, and reviewer access is required
raw daily bars can test historical endpoint reachability only
the Sina calendar is not accepted as sole authoritative common SSE/SZSE evidence
no complete locked publication-date, ST, suspension, lifecycle, or rights contract is implied
the AKShare MIT software licence does not license upstream returned data
actual report publication dates and complete historical ST/suspension states are not established by the public adapter
adjustment and delisting endpoint semantics require a separate review
client-code licensing does not grant publication rights for service data

fundamentals: issuer disclosure documents and filing metadata

known_constraints: historical bulk extraction and machine-readable availability must be demonstrated
retain exact source documents and terms evidence
official pages do not replace a complete adjusted-close and tradability panel

fundamentals: point-in-time ROE and actual filing publication dates

known_constraints: this is a procurement option, not evidence that a contract is held
contract must allow local analysis, hash binding, controlled reviewer reruns, and aggregate reporting
a current snapshot must not be called revision history without versioned values and as-of timestamps

decision_rule: Select a primary source only after every required role has a documented endpoint, complete target coverage, semantic review, and written rights for local analysis plus the intended aggregate/publication and controlled-review outputs. Otherwise retain BLOCKED_FOR_STAGE2.
